mods.name: Alloy Area Scanner
mods.changelog: New Alloy look: the scanner screen now matches Alloy Hub (Settings, Custom blocks and Presets tabs, block suggestions as you type, confirm before deleting a preset). Own Alloy Hub page with a Custom blocks tab. HUD follows the Alloy theme. Your settings, hotkeys, custom list and presets carry over.

mods.name: Alloy Backups
mods.changelog: New Nocturne look: the backup menu, settings, chunk selector and dialogs use the Alloy theme. Mod Menu button. Commands, settings and backups are unchanged.

mods.name: Alloy Bot Macros
mods.changelog:
New Nocturne look: every Bot Macros screen now matches Alloy Hub (Alloy UI is bundled).
New settings screen for all options and keys, from the menu's Settings button, /bm config or Mod Menu. MaLiLib is no longer needed for settings.
All menu and chat text is translatable.

mods.name: Alloy Carpet
mods.changelog:
easyDispenserRecipe: sticks and string can now be swapped (string on the diagonal, sticks in the column)
While the rule is on, the easy dispenser recipe is added to every player's recipe book; turning it off removes it

mods.name: Alloy Container
mods.changelog: - Fixed: the storage menu (Y) lowered your FPS with a big storage. It now only draws the rows you can see.

mods.name: Alloy Creative
mods.changelog:
New menu in the Alloy (Nocturne) look; MaLiLib is no longer needed
Sections: Regions, Selection, Labs, Gallery, Camera, Modules, Settings
Deleting asks in a confirm dialog
Hotkeys are normal Minecraft key bindings (set them again: old MaLiLib bindings don't carry over)
Camera options moved to Settings; Mod Menu's config button opens the menu

mods.name: Alloy FX
mods.changelog:
Settings in game, armor per piece, safer on busy servers
- /cytrafx settings lists every setting, /cytrafx set <key> <value> changes one (new: soundVolume, soundRange, swordSounds, armorOnEntities, usePicks, relayPicks, disabledThemes, particleBudget)
- Alloy Pack Mixer theme picks per armor piece (helmet, chestplate, leggings, boots)
- Fixed a server crash when smashAmount is 0
- Busy places stay light: held-weapon particles per player are capped (particleBudget)
- A config file with a typo is kept as cytrafx.json.broken instead of being wiped
- /cytrafx shows the version; /cytrafx cleanup puts themed armor back to normal before removing the mod
- Use Alloy Pack 1.5.1 as the server resource pack

mods.name: Alloy Hub
mods.changelog:
- Up-to-date changelogs for every Alloy mod (Map, Pack Mixer, Container, Area Scanner, Bot Macros, Ledger, Link, Mass Craft, Shulker View, Syncmatica, Backups, Carpet, Creative, Printer, Trades, Waypoints, Sticky Toggle, Return Cannon Maker)
- Alloy FX in the catalog
- Alloy Waypoints page uses the mod's own settings list (2.9.0+)
- Open Alloy Carpet menu and Syncmatica Open settings actions

mods.name: Alloy Ledger
mods.changelog:
Inventory rollback: /ll inv <player> lists inventory snapshots (taken on death before the drops, on logout, every 10 minutes when changed, and before a restore)
View a snapshot's inventory or ender chest in a read-only chest, or restore it (op 3): inventory, ender chest and XP
New config: snapshotInventories, inventorySnapshotMinutes, maxInventorySnapshots

mods.name: Alloy Map
mods.changelog:
- Fixed: on big worlds the auto-render made the server fall behind until players timed out or it froze; map saving now runs in the background and the auto-render slows down with players online and pauses when the server is behind
- Map data for players is prepared once per region and shared

mods.name: Alloy Map
mods.changelog:
- Fixed: on big worlds the auto-render made the server fall behind until players timed out or it froze; map saving now runs in the background and the auto-render slows down with players online and pauses when the server is behind
- Map data for players is prepared once per region and shared

mods.name: Alloy Mass Craft
mods.changelog:
New Alloy look: the Mass Craft panel uses the Alloy theme (Nocturne, or the theme you picked in Alloy Hub)
Primary buttons are filled (Craft, Confirm), themed text boxes, progress bar and search list
Works with Alloy Container 1.4.1 (now the minimum)

mods.name: Alloy Pack Mixer
mods.changelog:
Smoother menu, real themed armour, more settings
- The menu no longer freezes when it opens: item previews are drawn in the background
- Themed armour uses the Alloy Pack's own textures (all their detail), and a Femboy helmet shows as cat ears
- Armour themes per piece: Helmet, Chestplate, Leggings and Boots on the THEMES tab
- The 3D item models switch works again (it had slid under the bottom bar); the ALLOY and THEMES settings now scroll
- New settings: particles in first person, particle amount, sound volume, share theme picks
- Themed sounds still play on servers with an older Alloy FX
- /alloythemes shows what the mixer sees for each nearby player

mods.name: Alloy Printer
mods.changelog:
New settings screen in the Alloy look: Printer, Accuracy, Blocks and Extras tabs
Alloy Hub page: printing switch, status, settings, quick actions and the status box position
Ops can turn the server placement helper on or off from the Hub's Server tab
Block lists are typed as one line, like stone, #minecraft:logs
Printer messages are translatable

mods.name: Alloy Send
mods.changelog: Cytra Send is now Alloy Send. Renamed from Cytra to Alloy, with the new Alloy logo. Nothing else changes: settings, commands and saved data stay the same.

mods.name: Alloy Shulker View
mods.changelog:
- New settings screen in the Alloy look: open it from Mod Menu, or bind Open settings under Controls (no key by default)
- All settings in one place: item icon, fill bar, icon sizes, label distance, named shulker textures, bar colours
- Follows the theme picked in Alloy Hub

mods.name: Alloy Sticky Toggle
mods.changelog:
Settings screen in the Alloy look (works without MaLiLib)
Alloy Hub page with every block and setting
Renamed to Alloy Sticky Toggle

mods.name: Alloy Syncmatica
mods.changelog:
- Material lists read schematic size correctly, so /cytra-syncmatica where shows the real centre and distance
- New settings screen in the Alloy look (Settings button in the material screen, openSettings hotkey)
- Chinese translation completed for everything added since 1.0

mods.name: Alloy Trades
mods.changelog:
New settings screen in the Alloy look: tool row, favourites you can reorder or remove (with a confirm), toasts
All text is now translatable
Hint when a stick is set as the trade tool while Litematica is loaded

mods.name: Alloy Waypoints
mods.changelog:
New Alloy look for the waypoint menu, routes and forms (follows your Hub theme)
Settings screen (gear in the menu, or Mod Menu): on/off, Xaero sync, Esc-menu button, default sort, remember last view, menu key
Add to Xaero, Edit, Set status, Teleport and Remove are in the ⋯ menu; Remove asks first
Server answers show as pop-ups

mods.name: Cytra Link
mods.changelog: Built with the same tools as the other Alloy mods; nothing changes on the server.

mods.name: Return Cannon Maker
mods.changelog: - Built with the same tools as the other Alloy mods (Java 21); nothing changes in game
